_comment: Favours and contacts (Expansion 6 C.7, docs/ADVENTURES.md §8.10; game/story/favours.py). A favour owed is spent as a way through an obstacle that has a `favour` block (situations.predicaments.json) and lies within the giver's reach: their town, a faction they share, their trade. `kinds`: what each kind of favour opens (obstacle kinds) and its words; `weights`: how heavy a favour an obstacle needs (by obstacle kind; `_default`). A shelter favour also hides you where you are wanted (`hide`). Contacts send word by runner when you come to their town and by letter when you are away (`letters`), open their door at night, and warn you when the watch has your description (`warn`); each kind deals as it does (`contacts`).

word.name: a word in the right ear

shelter.name: a roof and a hiding place

call: {giver} sends me. {giver_they_cap} said you would remember {giver_them}.
You know {giver} of {giver_town}. {giver_they_cap} owes me, and now you owe {giver_them}.
{giver} asked me to say {giver_their} name to you. And to ask this as a kindness.
I come from {giver}. {giver_they_cap} said to tell you it is time.
Ask {giver} about me, if you like. {giver_they_cap} will say the same.
own: You said you owed me, {giver}. I am asking now.
Do you remember what you said? That if I ever needed anything. I need this.
{giver}, you owe me one. This is it.
answer: ...{giver}. Well. If {giver_they} vouches for you, that is different.
For {giver}? All right. Not for you. For {giver_them}.
{giver} has done more for me than I can say. Very well.
If {giver} asks it, it is done. Tell {giver_them} we are square.
You might have said so at the start. For {giver}, yes.

label: The watch is looking for me. Can you hide me a while?
I need a roof nobody knows about. You said, once, that I could ask.
Hide me. Just for a few days. Please.
say: In here. Quickly. Nobody comes up to the loft but me.
Of course. You hid nothing for me, but you did more. The back room is yours.
Get in before someone sees. And keep away from the window.
after: You spend {days} days in {giver}'s house, fed on what {giver_they} can spare. When you come out, the watch of {realm} have other things on their minds.
{days} days under {giver}'s roof, and not a soul knew. The watch of {realm} have half forgotten your face.

informant.name: hears things
runner: A boy finds you at the gate, out of breath: {giver} sends word.
A girl slips a folded note into your hand and is gone before you can thank her: {giver}'s writing.
Someone falls into step beside you for a moment. "From {giver}," they say, and are gone.
letter: A letter finds you, sealed with a thumbprint in wax. It is from {giver} in {giver_town}.
A carter puts a letter in your hand: "From {giver}, in {giver_town}. Paid for already."
A pedlar has a letter for you, folded small: {giver} of {giver_town} writes.
ask: What is the talk these days?
says: Listen, then. And you did not hear it from me.
Not much gets past me. Here is what I have.
trouble: And this: {asker} of {town} has trouble at home. Go and see {asker_them}.
One more thing. In {town}, {asker} needs someone. Nobody else will go.
They say {asker} of {town} is in a bad way. You might be the one to help.
nothing: Quiet, for once. Ask me again in a few days.
Nothing worth your coin. Nothing at all.

fence.name: buys what should not be sold
runner: A boy finds you at the gate: {giver} has buyers waiting, if you have anything to sell. After dark, the back door.
A note in a child's hand: "Come by when the lamps are out. G." It is {giver}'s way of saying hello.
letter: A letter from {giver} in {giver_town}, written so that it says nothing at all to anyone but you: the market is good.

smuggler.name: has what the shops do not
runner: A boy finds you at the gate: {giver} has had a cart in from the hills. Things the shops don't sell.
Someone brushes past you: "{giver} says the boat came in."
letter: {giver} writes from {giver_town}: new goods, the kind that come in at night. Come when you can.

healer.name: will see to your wounds at any hour
runner: A boy finds you at the gate: {giver} heard you were back, and says to come by if anything needs stitching.
{giver} has sent a child with a pot of salve and a message: come and be looked at.
letter: A letter from {giver} in {giver_town}, mostly about your health and how little you look after it.

scholar.name: knows what strange things are
runner: A boy finds you at the gate: {giver} has been reading, and wants to see anything strange you have found.
A note from {giver}, in a careful hand: bring whatever you have that nobody can name.
letter: {giver} writes from {giver_town}, three closely written pages of old names and older stories, and at the end: come and see me.

runner: {giver} sends word, and it is not good: the watch of {realm} have your description. Keep your hood up and keep off the main street.
"From {giver}," a boy whispers: "the watch know your face. They are at the gate and the market. Go round."
A note from {giver}: they are looking for you here. They know what you look like. Be quick and be careful.
letter: A letter from {giver} in {giver_town}, hurried and short: the watch of {realm} have your description. Stay away, or come in quiet.
{giver} writes from {giver_town}: your name is on the watch's lips in {realm}. They know your face. Mind the gates.

knock: You knock softly. After a while {giver} opens the door, a candle in {giver_their} hand, and lets you in.
A quiet knock, the way {giver} showed you. The bolt slides back.
{giver} is awake almost before you knock, and lets you in without a word.
vouch: {giver} is here, and says you are a friend of the house.
{giver} steps between you and the others: "It's all right. I let them in."
